LanguageData.LP_EldritchBlast.label: eldritch blast
LanguageData.LP_EldritchBlast.description: A pact spell every signer knows: a beam of force (range 24), each beam 12 eldritch damage (armor penetration 30%). Number of beams by adventurer level: 1 at levels 1-4, 2 at 5-10, 3 at 11-16, 4 from 17; if the target falls, the remaining beams automatically fire at nearby enemies. Nine Hells patrons: 20% to ignite; fey patrons: 15% to confuse the target for 2 seconds. Cooldown 4 seconds. Lost when the pact ends.
LanguageData.LP_SummonHornedDevil.label: summon horned devil
LanguageData.LP_SummonHornedDevil.description: Summon a horned devil under the pact with Asmodeus to serve as your servant for 5 days. Cooldown 15 days (×2 while in debt).
LanguageData.LP_SummonIceDevil.label: summon ice devil
LanguageData.LP_SummonIceDevil.description: Summon an ice devil under the pact with Mephistopheles to serve as your servant for 5 days, leaving normally when the term ends. Cooldown 15 days (×2 while in debt).
LanguageData.LP_SummonRedcaps.label: summon redcaps
LanguageData.LP_SummonRedcaps.description: Summon 4 redcaps under the pact with the Queen of Air and Darkness to serve as your servants for 3 days. Cooldown 1 quarter (×2 while in debt).
LanguageData.LP_WinterVeil.label: winter's veil
LanguageData.LP_WinterVeil.description: Let a layer of winter mist fall: enemies within 6 cells make a Wisdom save (difficulty rises with the signer's proficiency bonus and Charisma; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or are charmed for 6 seconds. Cooldown 1 day (×2 while in debt).
LanguageData.LP_SummerTouch.label: summer's touch
LanguageData.LP_SummerTouch.description: Press a palm on the wound and summer's light closes it: heals a colonist's worst wound (not missing parts). Cooldown 1 day (×2 while in debt).
